$description: Databricks, as AppKit apps are branded: Databricks AppKit UI (@databricks/appkit-ui 0.81.0) with the dbx-tools brand bridge and default brand (@dbx-tools/ui-appkit, @dbx-tools/ui-branding, @dbx-tools/shared-core 0.9.43), documented at https://docs.dbx.tools/packages/ui-appkit. Identity colours (primary, primary-hover, accent, foreground, background, surface, muted, border) are the dbx-tools default brand context; states are AppKit's success, warning and destructive. The brand bridge leaves AppKit's neutrals in place for dark, so dark uses AppKit's dark neutrals with the brand's identity colours. Colours moved for contrast say so.
